english_full:
Although the ineffable name is the property of clemency, it should not

be denied that it contains the property of judgment.

28.4. The sin of Adam was the severing of kingdom from the other shoots.

28.5. With the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, in which the first man

sinned, God created the world.
